# Deployment reference

Entrypoint, unit and bind values generated from `Dockerfile`, `renderUnit` and the config defaults.

## Container

- `FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.26.11-bookworm AS build`
- `FROM scratch AS distroless`
- `USER 65532:65532`
- `ENTRYPOINT ["/damnbot"]`
- `CMD ["serve"]`

Default web bind: `127.0.0.1:7878` (config.DefaultWebListen).

## systemd user unit

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Damn-Bot daemon (damnbot serve)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/damnbot serve --bind 127.0.0.1:7878 --data-dir ~/.local/share/damnbot
EnvironmentFile=-%h/.config/damnbot/telegram.env
Environment=DAMNBOT_SUPERVISOR=systemd
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
RestartPreventExitStatus=78
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=45
KillMode=mixed
KillSignal=SIGTERM
LimitNOFILE=8192
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
```
